text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that minor street stop signs be installed at five uncontrolled three-way intersections in the Chelwood Road area in order to clearly define the right-of-way and to regulate traffic flow.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory stop control for southbound traffic on Woodfern Drive at Chelwood Road. 2. Authorized compulsory stop control for southbound traffic on Ashwick Drive at Chelwood Road. 3. Authorized compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Ashwick Drive at Woodfern Drive. 4. Authorized compulsory stop control for southbound traffic on Bonniewood Road at Ashwick Drive (west intersection). 5. Authorized compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Bonniewood Road at Ashwick Drive (east intersection).
